name: 点と線・人物の印で担当者別の作業を示すグラフのひな型
prompt:
Recreate the standalone Asana chart tile in the primary source crop. Match its 300:206 aspect ratio (about 1.46:1), full rounded white card, faint neutral border, inner padding and original chart placement. The source controls geometry, four marker positions, bar lengths, blue color and the four photographic avatars; use the Japanese mock only for the title wording.

At the top left, use the compact Japanese title 「担当者ごとの今週の作業」 in dark, medium-weight type. Keep it on one line if it fits naturally. Below it, reproduce the source’s sparse lollipop chart: exactly four bright-blue circular points, each with a thin vertical blue line descending to one small circular source-style portrait at the baseline.

Preserve the source order and positions: first point highest, second lower, third between the first and second, and fourth lowest. Keep all four avatar portraits along one shared baseline. The chart occupies only the left half of the tile, as in the original; leave the broad right half empty. Include the single very faint horizontal guide behind the points.

Use four distinct tiny photographic headshots in the same order and scale as the original. Do not replace them with initials, colored circles, labels, values or names. Do not add axes, extra guides, a legend, extra points or page context.
reviewNotes: Candidate v001 compared side-by-side with the original 2x crop. Dimensions 1513x1039 (1.4562:1) against source 300x206 (1.4563:1); SHA-256 1bb4646693e77d5654880ebd8dcdcda538d9af7d3a8c9de46785bd98b3b1257e. The four x positions, point order, blue lollipop marks and portrait count are correct. The complete chart group, guide and shared avatar baseline sit about 7% too high. Status: needs-correction; one focused revision remains.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
